milter_enabled.description: Enable the Amavisd milter interface (required for integration with MTA milters like Postfix or Sendmail).

milter_socket_type.description: Socket type for milter communication: 'unix' for a Unix domain socket, 'inet' for TCP.

milter_socket_path.description: Path to Unix socket (only used if milter_socket_type = 'unix').

milter_bind_address.description: IP address to bind the milter TCP listener to (only used if milter_socket_type = 'inet').

milter_bind_port.description: TCP port to listen on for milter connections (only used if milter_socket_type = 'inet').

milter_max_procs.description: Maximum number of worker processes for handling milter connections.

milter_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for milter communication between the MTA and Amavisd.

milter_allowed_clients.description: List of allowed client addresses (CIDR or hostnames) permitted to use this milter.

milter_debug.description: Debug level for milter logging (0–4); higher values produce more verbose logs.
